peg_reference.notes: USDM historically targeted one U.S. dollar; Phase 3 provides an on-chain stablecoin reserve and exit mechanism during wind-down.

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: USDM was designed to rebase balances from reserve income; current behavior must be interpreted within the Phase 3 wind-down structure.

classification_notes: Winding-down rebasing stablecoin. Normal issuance and issuer-platform redemption are terminated even though token and pool functions remain.
